description: Urban Heat Islands (UHI) Krefeld is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices.krzn.de. With the help of this data, particularly heavily heated districts as well as cooler, more climatically balanced zones can be identified. The Urban Heat Island (UHI) effect describes the phenomenon that urban space is increasingly heating up vis-à-vis the surrounding rural regions. Coverage: the city of Krefeld. Its keywords include Stadtklimamodell, Stadt Krefeld, Hitzeinseln, Urban Heat Island, Wärmeinseln, Urban Heat Index. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
